answer: One defense roots each agent identity in a costly, non-refundable compute bond: to enlist, an agent must solve a cipher-hard puzzle keyed to a unique seed, grinding a result as dense and immovable as basalt. A Sybil fleet pays this toll once per fake identity, so cloning stops being free. Peers then mirror each newcomer claimed work against the ledger, rejecting any node whose bond or history it cannot independently reproduce.
